notes.title: Update 2.5.1 - Fixes, strength adjustments and transcendent items
notes.content:
Version 2.5.1 is here with important fixes from version 2.5.0, plus there was a tweak to the refno and also a BIG change to the strength of the latest item rarities, and we're going to talk a little bit about that change here.

In the early days of Wing, transcendent items were presented as scarce items of unparalleled strength, but with constant upgrades and stat increases, transcendent items showed little different from other item types, with the refining system becoming obvious that a transcendent item can become a disadvantage.

So we rebalanced the power leap of a transcendent, sacred and divine item.

[b]Finally, let's go to the version 2.5.1 log![/b]
- Rarity multiplier on divine, sacred and transcendent significantly increased.
-Refining multiplier reduced from 5 to 4.
-Improved server stability.
-Fixed bug where disabled cores would not remove cores from equipment
-Fixed bug where in some cases, enchanting or upgrading items cost more than it should.
-Fixed bug where the bank would confuse item data and show wrong orders or items.
-Fixed bug where the max mana show was scaling wrong with itens that have enchant.

We will continue to monitor the impact of the refine/rarity system within the game which may be adjusted in future updates.

notes.title: Update 2.5.0 - Free Exchange, Item Enchantment and Fixes
notes.content:
Version 2.5.0 is here! It took some time as the team is focused on WOM: Worlds, but the pace of Retro updates should get back to normal as soon as we finish organizing the new development team dedicated to Retro.

For now, we're bringing you some of the most requested systems by the community of WOM: Retro!

Without further ado, let's get to the version log [b]2.5.0[/b]!

[b]New item enchantment system![/b]
Currently equipment could be improved just by adding runes in its empty spaces, now, in addition to runes, you can enchant equipment from level 1 to 30!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XOFA14j.png[/img]

How it works:

From level 1 to 20, you need 1 equipment of the same level and rarity, and 1 arkin gem to attempt the enchantment, there is no chance to regress.

From level 20 to 30, you need 1 equipment of the same level and rarity, and 1 corrupted arkin gem to attempt the enchantment, if it fails, the item loses 1 enchantment level.

Level 30 is the maximum enchantment and will strengthen your item considerably.

[b]Character change gift[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/onRZoZu.png[/img]

For all players who have a subscription (with poporo point or with WP), 1 free character change will be delivered every 1st of the month, if the player already has a change on the day, it will not accumulate.

[b]Improvements[/b]
-Added a checkbox in the professions window so that the player can choose if he wants a continuous creation/improvement process or by mouse click

[b]Balance items[/b]
[b]Ancient Helmet[/b]
Heal life based: 8% to 4%

[b]Lacent[/b]
Daamage life based: 18% to 15%

[b]Bugs fixed[/b]
-Bug where when losing connection for any reason, the client could not try to reconnect
-Bug where failing to insert runes did not weaken items with a 10% chance
-Bug where the Steam store failed to launch on WP purchases

[b]The update will be applied in-game on the 12th! The server will shut down on 10/12 03:00 UTC and should return on 10/12 05:00 UTC.[/b]

[b]The future[/b]
We want to continue the previous planning to release Serai Fin and the improvements to the game's ranked PVP system, however, the next content update will take some time to happen as the 4Tabern team undergoes a restructuring.

We are committed to trying to please the Retro community as much as possible! So be sure to create your feedback on our discord!

WOM: Retro will continue to evolve and a different branch of WOM: Worlds, but it is important to note that the game will continue to be developed and improved, receiving content and updates from the WOM universe, in the long term we have important things to do in Retro:

Companion system rework
Battle of companions
Visual map update
Client portability to mobile

Thanks for being with us this far, it's been at least 7 years of development! We will keep working to bring you a better and better WOM!

notes.title: Update 2.4.0 - Enhancement 10, boar idols and visuals
notes.content:
Update 2.4.0 is here with some new features, in this version we focus on a little more content for the 2.0 series, in this version there is no balance, but in a few days we should bring some usability improvements for characters like Arita.

Without delay, let's go to the 2.4.0 version log!

General
-New maps: Dragovados Fields and Berratrolls Fields, one is in Lilia and the other in Lotos.
-Now it is possible to reach the level 10 of improvement!
-Now it is possible to reach level 120, the maximum until then was 110.
-New type of equipment: The Idols, items that for now are only dropped on new maps.
-Two boar visuals have been added to the Wing Points store: The Asteros Boar and the Dead Boar.
-Some professions were fixed because they were with incorrect values in the previous version.
-There have been some usability improvements made to the profession interface that should make it easier for beginners to understand.
-A few interaction indicators have been added in the Temple of 15 so that novices have less difficulty in the tutorial.
-The planting limit on the maps has been considerably increased. -Now missions to defeat monsters in guilds can be done in groups.

notes.title: Updates 2.3.9.1 & 2.3.9.2 - Fix and adjusts
notes.content:
In the last few days we released two updates solving the problems of this series, there were several fixes and we brought everything in the shortest time possible, and that is why we have not yet posted the update log for that version.

Without delay, check the log for versions 2.3.9.1 and 2.3.9.2!

General

2.3.9.1
-Fixed bug where it was possible to add a friend and at the same time he could add you by duplicating the information in the database
and preventing some players from entering your characters.
-Fixed bug where the mount generated an error in some cases closing the game.
-Fixed bug in which Aiprah's passive motivation did not restart the duration after reaching the limit.
-Fixed bug where the Ancestral Helmet did not give the attack speed correctly.
-Fixed bug where the Noctis Helmet did not give the attack speed correctly.
-Fixed bug where the player was not removed from the mount in some types of primary attacks.
-Fixed bug in the new hats visuals added in this version, the visuals are already activated again.
-Fixed visual bug in Chihiro in which her blonde hair disappeared with some hats.
-Fixed visual bug in Lupi where his pink hair disappeared with some hats.

2.3.9.2
-Fixed bug where Surbos and Orbus did not damage their abilities.
-Fixed bug where some jumping skills did not perform an auto attack.
-Fixed bug where it was possible to create characters using special character nicknames, creating some processing conflicts for the server.
-Fixed bug where accepting an exchange invitation with a player who left the map created an error.
-Fixed bug where in rare cases an error could occur in battle against npcs.
-Fixed bug where physical damage reduction buffs only applied to damage from basic attacks.
-Fixed bug where some types of ranged attacks did not activate item passives.
-Fixed bug in which when Baltus was killed he did not correctly process the bonus and exp message.
-Fixed bug where the Lava Pyromancer did not drop the Pyromancer's staff.
-Fixed bug where Surbos did not drop the Surbosban Gloves.
-Fixed bug in which when adding a friend the message appeared that he was already your friend.
-Now Infestos drops the correct items from the infested set and not from the conspirator.

notes.title: Update 2.3.9.0 - A new beginning
notes.content:
Hello! It’s been a while since we’ve brought an update to the Misadventure universe, this will probably be the BIGGEST and cutest update we’ve brought so far, with news a LOT of news, let’s explore the evolution of Misadventure. This is the first quarter and we have one as big as this one to come in the next, don’t worry, we’re working at full speed on an even better Wing!

Without delay, let's go to the version 2.3.9.0 log!

General
-Now Wing will be automatically detected by video cards from AMD or NVidia.
-Some interface improvements have been made that you should visually notice when the version arrives.
-Now you can also login with your site username.
-Now you will not be able to play if you do not confirm your account email on our website.
-The login screen has been redone and now besides being faster there is a Lala running on a Boar.
-New command customization options have been added in the game preferences.
-The control has been activated and now works correctly.
-The control resistance has now been activated and now works correctly.
-Now you need to be at least level 20 to open a shop in game.
-Now you need to have certain character levels to send some types of messages in the chat.
-The power calculation has been revised and now it also no longer considers character passive values.
-New power ranking and ranking system in the Iamai tournament.
-New collection features for farmers have been added to the tutorial map, to be implemented on other maps soon.
-New profession: Jeweler, create rings and amulets!
-Now low-level items drop from monsters less often but have a significantly greater chance of coming with a good rarity.
- Several compatibility and performance improvements have been made in the game that should significantly improve the FPS.
-It is now possible to activate or deactivate VSync in the game configuration.
-It is now possible to choose the FPS limit in the game configuration.
-New Ruined fort map with 6 new monsters,
-22 new equipment, some for the fort and others for existing maps.
-New Astra companion.
-Now the Hat of Thanksgiving has its own look.
-4 new missions for lower level players.
-New system: The Time Breakers are now functional and can take you to some places.
-New mount system, it's time to run around on a wild boar!
-Rework complete of the tutorial map with new teachings, visual and objective.
-Complete work by Invartam.
-Fixed bug where the Redem Csa accessory of the standard hair did not appear on his head.
-Fixed bug where the Bellator Sword passive was activated in side effect attacks.
-Fixed bug in which the "damaged" state was applied in real damage effects.
-Fixed bug where Ecnos passive multiplied Noah's instability effects creating a never ending damage sequence.
-Fixed bug where the passive and Ecnos was in conflict with Taiga's poisoning ability.
-Fixed bug in which in some cases leaving invisibility would take the player's position out of sync.
-Fixed bug in which in some cases jumping took the player's position out of sync.
-Fixed bug where it was possible to push map resources through some spells.
-Fixed bug where it was possible to sit while taking a potion without canceling the potion's effect.
-Fixed bug in which the Rhythm of the Battle of May did not increase the damage of basic attacks.
-Fixed bug where the recipe of Reconchavólver was incorrect.
-Fixed bug where the Warrior Spear recipe was incorrect.
-Fixed bug in which in some situations cast spells are not canceled after the player's death
-Fixed bug in which in some cases silence skills do not cancel the cast.
-Fixed bug where the Secret of Protection is not correctly reset when exiting a battle at the Iamai Tournament.
-Fixed error in the description of the Aiprah Disintegration ability, the correct one is "in the current life" not "in the maximum life".
-Fixed bug in which Anne's Sacrifice passive conflicts with some invocations applying the PK state to the master himself.
-Fixed bug in which Cerejeira gave less exp than the other trees in the profession of lumberjack.
-Fixed bug where Alice's Indolence Key passive accumulated with side effects by activating the passive several times.
-Fixed bug where "Burning" status did not affect regeneration effects.
-Fixed bug where the Aiprahs Catalyzing ability was not multiplying the damage correctly based on passive stacks.
-Fixed bug where chests opened on the map disappeared instead of being left open on the map.
-Fixed bug in which the passive "The Exiled Commander" was consumed in the use of some abilities.
-Fixed bug where the duration of some older skills was not scaling correctly with the level.
-Fixed bug where secondary attacks remove players from invisibility.
-A number of structural improvements have been made to the server and Wing and should improve your ping by approximately 2 to 8.
-The list of friends had its structure changed and the way it is saved on the server too, so you will need to add your friends again through our website or the game.

Balances
Mana and life bonuses granted by guilds (per level): 2.4% to 1.2%.
Now blindness applies to all types of physical damage.

New evolution for the elemental up:
Taking damage generates neutral experience based on your defense, the Anti AFK system has been improved for the arrival of this new concept and there will be specific rules for how the system works.

The control effect was finally implemented and it works as follows (remembering that the items had the value of modified control):
Each 1 control point equals 0.01 seconds in the duration of the damaged state and generates greater chances of keeping monsters.
focused on you.
Each 1 point of resistance to control is equivalent to 1% reduction in control states (but does not apply to the damaged state).

Change to critical damage (physical only):
Critical damage now has 85% increased damage, before it was 50%.

New effects for items:
We have created a new status logic for items based on item classes: Fighter, Assassin, Tank, Mage and Sniper.
With that, some items had their defense status removed and the damage considerably increased, others were leveled between strength, life and damage, others just defense and life and etc...

The physical penetration effect has been added for some in-game items. (maximum to be reached as 30%)
The magic penetration effect has been added for some in-game items. (maximum to be reached as 10%)

Penetration of physical defense based on power: 0.5% to 0.4%.
Magic defense penetration based on magic potency: 0.1% to 0.08%.

The concept of the boots has also been changed and they no longer grant elements to grant attributes based on their own item class.

Movement speed (base): 20 to 30.

Dawn of War - Azura
Now Azura does not advance on the second punch if it has not pushed an enemy (or an enemy has resisted the push).

tags.feature: -Now Wing will be automatically detected by video cards from AMD or NVidia.
-Some interface improvements have been made that you should visually notice when the version arrives.
-Now you can also login with your site username.
-Now you will not be able to play if you do not confirm your account email on our website.

-New command customization options have been added in the game preferences.
-The control has been activated and now works correctly.
-The control resistance has now been activated and now works correctly.
-Now you need to be at least level 20 to open a shop in game.
-Now you need to have certain character levels to send some types of messages in the chat.
-The power calculation has been revised and now it also no longer considers character passive values.

-New collection features for farmers have been added to the tutorial map, to be implemented on other maps soon.
-New profession: Jeweler, create rings and amulets!
-Now low-level items drop from monsters less often but have a significantly greater chance of coming with a good rarity.
- Several compatibility and performance improvements have been made in the game that should significantly improve the FPS.
-It is now possible to activate or deactivate VSync in the game configuration.
-It is now possible to choose the FPS limit in the game configuration.
-New Ruined fort map with 6 new monsters,
-22 new equipment, some for the fort and others for existing maps.
-New Astra companion.
-Now the Hat of Thanksgiving has its own look.
-4 new missions for lower level players.
-New system: The Time Breakers are now functional and can take you to some places.
-New mount system, it's time to run around on a wild boar!
-Rework complete of the tutorial map with new teachings, visual and objective.
-Complete work by Invartam.

notes.title: Update 2.3.8.10 - Corrections, adjustments and balances
notes.content:
The update 2.3.8.10 has arrived and with it we are trying to give a special affection to gaf! In addition to making some important adjustments before bringing the Ruined Fort and the new mount system.

Without delay, let's go to the log of version 2.3.8.10!

General
-Unique or higher rarity items now have a special animation on the map.
-Added a channel for factions in the chat, to send messages to the faction chat type /f before the text.
-The passive items that were not activated have been activated and are already working.
-You can now see the percentage of experience of each element.
-Now by pressing CTRL and marking a target with the right button through an invocation, the interaction window does not open.
-Now when you try to sell, drop, or transfer an item, the text box is already filled with the item value.
-Fixed bug where the element of the day shown in the bottom corner of the screen was a day late.
-Fixed bug where iamai tournament ended up pulling AFK players or with open store.
-Fixed a bug where iamai's tournament could pull a player while he switched map, causing the player's map not to be properly loaded.
-Fixed bug where in some cases some buffs did not disappear and created excess particles affecting the game's FPS.

Balancing
Physical penetration of monsters
15% to 18%.

Adjust on Life Steal
Hitting more than 5 targets reduces the effect to 20% of the total.

Level 80 items have undergone minor modifications to better suit the physical damage.

Ograad

The exiled commander - Gaf
Regeneration effect removed.
New effect: If you stay 10 seconds without taking damage generates a shield equivalent to 30% (+4% per skill level) of your maximum life with no time limit. [The bonus does not occur while you already have a larger shield]
New effect: While Gaf have a shield, his magic and physical defense is increased by 30%(+4% per skill level).

King's Legacy - Gaf
Protection duration: 3 seconds to 4 seconds.
New effect: Gaf heals by 1+(0.7 multiplier of the earth element) 2 seconds after casting.
New effect: Gaf gains a shield equivalent to 18% (+3% per skill level) of his maximum health 2 seconds after casting lasting 5 seconds.

Pression - Prai Las
Stun time: 0.5 seconds to 1 second.

Lunge
Slow duration: 1 second to 2 seconds.

Dragon Retreat - Prai Las
Slow duration: 0.5 seconds to 1.5 seconds.

Hot Blood
Health regeneration (base): 2.5% to 3.5%
Health regeneration (per level): 0.5% to 1%.


Ritelf

Defender
Defense multiplier (per level): 0.175 to 0.075.

Cuirass
Damage reduction (per level): 0.008 to 0.003.

notes.title: Update 2.3.8.9 - Update 2.3.8.9f - Corrections and balances
notes.content:
And here we are with the latest update of 2020! This year was full of important moments for Wing, difficult moments and happy moments! In this topic we would like to contemplate with our community the advancement of the universe of Misadventure, thank you all for another year at our side! In this update we are bringing the latest adjustments to this series and you can celebrate in style christmas and new year! We are delivering by the end of the 25th a coupon to change avatar and a scroll of skill reset!

Without delay, let's go to the log of version 2.3.8.9f!

[b]General[/b]

notes.title: Update 2.3.8.9 - Lapis Sol, physical and magic damage and more!
notes.content:
And here we are for another update, the first since Wing arrived in Steam. In this update we are bringing our children of knowledge, the Lapis Sol: our beloved Taiga, the first assassin of Lotos e Azura, the monk that everyone wanted to see in action.

We will keep an eye on the performance of these two new avatars, but this update has much more than that, the Santa Poporo event is active again, and you will be able to run after your Christmas hats, besides new companions are waiting for you!

Without delay, let's go to version 2.3.8.9 log!

[b]General[/b]
-The Lapis Sol came to Misadventure and can be already explored!
-Phasmo, the Magui swordsman was added to the Wing Points shop.
-Birdo, the combatant bird has been added to the game and can be obtained by drop
-Some animations have had their impact on performance reduced and this should positively influence the FPS.
-Sparticle management has been improved and this should positively influence the FPS.
-Now damage action messages are only sent to the one who received or took the damage, and not to the whole map.
-Now drag items from the inventory to the character window, equip the item.
-Now keep the CTRL button pressed and click the left mouse button on the items in the inventory, select them for sale or destruction. (just like the right mouse button already did)
-The Poporo Ho Ho Klaus event is activated in this version.
-The subscription price has been reduced, you can check the new price inside the game.
-In the NA server, we added 25% more WP in packages.
-Corrected bug in which in some cases pets on the map could cause an error in the game.
-Fixed bug in some cases when giving PK in more than one player, an error occurred in the game.
-Fixed bug in which in some cases, when entering a map an error could occur.


[b]Balancement[/b]
Some skills now cause physical damage, the difference from physical damage to the magician is that physical damage can cause critical damage and you can dodge it.

Check out the skills that now cause physical damage:

Damage (per level): 2.5% to 2.2%.

Shield duration: 7 segundos para 5 segundos.

[b]Ox Rubo[/b]

[b]Cani Kinch[/b]
Mastering
New effect: Your attacks have 12% + (+1% per skill level) magic defense penetration.
